fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-04-07, the complainant reported that a boundary wall near Roja Colony Residential Colony was extended into the land of the complainant without permission. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-04-06 at approximately 10:05. Inban Balan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000367. A grey van with registration TN-33-XX-1030 was observed near Roja Colony Residential Colony. Indhu Rani (9000000480) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Elango Shankar (mobile 9000000317) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Encroachment reportedly began after a dispute over survey records.
fields.Keywords: land encroachment, boundary dispute, suspect, residential colony, mobile number, witness, van, documents
